title: Spectral synthesis on Riemannian manifolds
summary: We study spectral synthesis for measures supported on thin subsets of compact Riemannian manifolds. We prove that under natural non-concentration conditions, such measures admit quantitative spectral synthesis, with explicit stability bounds. We show that this phenomenon depends strongly on the underlying geometry. On the torus, synthesis holds under broad assumptions, while on the sphere we establish rigidity results demonstrating that synthesis can fail in a sharp sense.
